artists.name: Mei Ling Chan
artists.note: Sings standards like they still owe her something. Residencies at small rooms off Hollywood Road, a voice that sits just behind the beat.

artists.name: Kai Rivera
artists.note: Writes songs in the back of a rehearsal warehouse and plays them like the walls might answer. Looking for a rhythm section that actually listens.

artists.name: Amina Hassan
artists.note: Builds tracks from field recordings and a stubborn analogue synth. Available for film cues, late rooftops, and anyone who still likes a long intro.

artists.name: Jun Park
artists.note: Writes in two languages and performs in one breath. Night-market cadence, studio discipline. Open to features that don’t sand him down.

artists.name: Sofia Berg
artists.note: Recital hall by afternoon, session work by night. Interested in electronic pairings and scores that leave the cello some air.

artists.name: Leo Tam
artists.note: Rooftop sessions and tight live bands. Writes in Cantonese first. Looking for players who can hold a chorus without crowding it.

artists.name: Nia Okonkwo
artists.note: A voice built for small rooms and long notes. Sundays at The Wanch, weekdays in session. Will not do a click-track ballad unless it earns it.

artists.name: Ryo Nakamura
artists.note: For hire, not for decoration. Pocket first, fills second. Available for residencies, records, and anyone tired of a drum machine.

artists.name: Tess Wong
artists.note: Quiet songs about leaving and coming back. Plays open tunings in rooms that still have ceiling fans.

artists.name: Hassan Malik
artists.note: Horns for hire, charts on request. Prefers small rooms and players who leave space.

artists.name: Yuki Cheung
artists.note: Warehouse edits and late buses home. First upload is sitting with Inner Soul for review.

artists.name: Daniel Ho
artists.note: Makes beats in a subdivided flat and names them after minibus routes. Open to Cantonese features.

artists.name: Clara Ip
artists.note: Session strings, quartet work, and the occasional pop overdub. Will not play over a loop that is already doing her job.

artists.name: Martin Sham
artists.note: Runs Inner Soul Records and still writes guitar parts after the office lights go off. Looking after the roster and the room.

artists.name: Sin Lam
artists.note: Voice first, paperwork second. Inner Soul on weekdays, small rooms on weekends.
